preamble: WHEREAS the Mussalman Wakf Validating Act, 1913, does not apply to wakfs created before its enactment; AND WHEREAS it is expedient to validate such wakfs without infringing any rights contrary thereto which may have already accrued or been acquired; It is hereby enacted as follows:—

body.text: This Act may be called the Mussalman Wakf Validating Act, 1930.

sections.title: Act VI of 1913 to apply retrospectively

body.text: The Mussalman Wakf Validating Act, 1913, shall be deemed to apply to wakfs created before its commencement:

Provided that nothing herein contained shall be deemed in any way to affect any right, title, obligation or liability already acquired, accrued or incurred before the commencement of this Act. <div class="
